item.text: {"paper_id":"paper119","profile_id":"cardiovascular","relevance":0,"evidence_quote":"Using 2011 and 2023 mortality data from Brazil and Mexico, we estimated HPV-attributable cancer deaths, years of life lost (YLL), average YLL, and years of potential productive life lost (YPPLL) by sex, age, and cancer type, applying attributable fractions.","rationale":"The study examines mortality and premature life loss from HPV-attributable cancers and cancer prevention.
